units.source_text: 相反，大竹夫人绝不在对局室里露面，

en.t: By contrast, Mrs. Otake never showed herself in the game room,

units.source_text: 她坐立不安地在走廊上来回踱步，

en.t: she paced restlessly back and forth in the corridor,

units.source_text: 说不定是由于不知所措，走进了工作人员的房间。

en.t: and perhaps because she did not know what to do, she went into the staff room.
